segments.text_en: The process of destroying old connections
evidence: From the great heaven Inana set her mind on the great below
Inana abandoned heaven, abandoned earth, and descended to the underworld
She abandoned the Eanna in Uruk, and descended to the underworld

segments.text_en: Collecting of seven divine powers, mostly related to appearance except measuring objects
evidence: She collected the divine powers and grasped them in her hand
She placed mascara “Let a man come, let him come” on her eyes
She held the lapis-lazuli measuring rod and measuring line in her hand

segments.text_en: Instruction to the minister of Inanna how to act during her absence
evidence: Her minister Ninšubur traveled behind her
make a lament for me on the ruin mounds
Lacerate your eyes for me, lacerate your nose for me
and all alone set your foot in the E-kur, the house of Enlil
lament before Nanna
Don’t let young lady Inanna be killed in the underworld
Father Enki, the lord of great wisdom
He is the one who will restore me to life

segments.text_en: The emphasis of the importance of the instructions
evidence: Go now, my Ninšubur, and pay attention
Don’t neglect the instructions I gave you

segments.text_en: The underworld realizes the unauthorized intrusion
evidence: she pushed aggressively on the door of the underworld
I am all alone and I want to come in
why have you traveled to the land of no return?
she offers generous libations at his wake; that is the reason
I will speak to my mistress Ereškigal and tell her what you have said

segments.text_en: The chief doorman tells his mistress his analyze of Inanna's intrusion
evidence: It is Inanna, your sister, and she has arrived at the palace Ganzer
She has abandoned Eanna and has descended to the underworld
She has collected the divine powers and grasped them in her hand
She has come on her way with all the good divine powers

segments.text_en: The instruction about taking away all clothes (divine powers) and special gate system
evidence: Let the seven gates of the underworld be bolted
and crouched down and had her clothes removed, they will be carried away
paid attention to the instructions of his mistress
He bolted the 7 gates of the underworld
Then he opened each of the doors of the palace Ganzer separately

segments.text_en: Each gate takes one of the divine powers fulfilling its needs
evidence: Come on, Inanna, and enter
the turban, headgear for the open country, was removed from her head
Be satisfied, Inanna, a divine power of the underworld has been fulfilled

segments.text_en: Inanna took the throne of her sister, but was sentenced to death
evidence: and instead she sat on her throne
The Anuna, the seven judges, rendered their decision against her
The afflicted woman was turned into a corpse

segments.text_en: Minister of Inanna follows the instructions, asks for help and got two rejections
evidence: her minister Ninšubur .. carried out the instructions of her mistress
She made a lament for her in her ruined (houses)
She lacerated her eyes for her, she lacerated her nose
she laments before Enlil
Father Enlil, don’t let anyone kill your daughter in the underworld
My daughter craved the great heaven and she craved the great below as well
for whoever gets them must remain in the underworld
In his rage father Nanna answers Ninšubur

segments.text_en: Enki decides to help Inanna
evidence: she laments before Enki
What has my daughter done? She has me worried
What has the mistress of all the lands done?

segments.text_en: Creation of two creatures that got the instruction how to save Inanna
evidence: Go and direct your steps to the underworld
Slip through the door pivots like phantoms
Her holy shoulders are not covered by a linen cloth.
You are troubled, our mistress, oh your heart
if you are mortals, may a destiny be decreed for you
They will offer you a riverful of water—don’t accept it
Give us the corpse hanging on the hook
Thus let Inanna rise up

segments.text_en: Creatures followed the instructions and made Inanna alive again
evidence: The gala-tura and the kur-gar paid attention to the instructions of Enki
I tell you from my heart to your heart, from my liver to your liver
they went on out
The corpse is that of your queen
1 of them sprinkled on it the life-giving plant and 1 the life-giving water
And thus Inanna rose up

segments.text_en: Inanna was stopped from ascending, enclosed by the underworld servants and has to find a substitute
evidence: But as Inanna was about to ascend from the underworld, the Anuna seized her
If Inanna is to ascend from the underworld, let her provide a substitute for herself
and the big demons, like the reeds of a fence, restrained her on all sides
They take away the child hanging on a wet-nurse’s breasts

segments.text_en: Demons suggested to take back Inanna's servant and got the rejection
evidence: Ninšubur threw herself at her feet at the door of the Ganzer
Inanna, proceed to your city, we will take her back
She did not forget my instructions
She brought me back to life
How could I turn her over to you?

segments.text_en: Travelling to other cities where rulers were prepared to meet Inanna in lamentation about her state
evidence: Šara, in his own city, threw himself at her feet
He had sat in the dust and dressed himself in a filthy garment
my manicurist and my hairdresser
Outstanding Lulal follows me at my right and my left
Let us go on

segments.text_en: Inanna found Dumuzi at her own place, demons caught him at once, he became the substitute for Inanna
evidence: There was Dumuzi clothed in a magnificent garment and seated magnificently on a throne
They would not let the shepherd play the pipe and flute before her
She looked at him, it was the look of death
Holy Inanna gave Dumuzi the shepherd into their hands

segments.text_en: Dumuzi is asking for a help a deity, turn parts of his body into a snake, escape
evidence: Dumuzi let out a wail and turned very pale
I am your relation by marriage. I brought butter oil to your mother’s house
Turn my hands into snake’s hands
Utu accepted his tears
Dumuzi escaped his demons

segments.text_en: Inanna falls in emotional disruption by the situation around Dumuzi
evidence: Holy Inanna wept bitterly for her husband
Where is my man?

segments.text_en: A fly provides a service and gets the destiny to live in abundance
evidence: If I show you where your man is, what will be my reward?
The young lady Inanna decreed the destiny of the fly
You will live like the sons of the wise

segments.text_en: A final agreement about substitution that is divided between Dumuzi and his sister
evidence: You for half the year and your sister for half the year
when your sister is demanded, on that day you will be released
sweet is your praise
